sources.scope: Existing model-specific grid definitions, saved destination masks and shared complete-image verifier; no new protocol interpretation for automatic paths.
Expanded status/data packing, driver timestamp and malformed short input; no driver or Fractal hardware qualification.

coverage: Independent complete body expectations for automatic shunts/cables
Idempotence, obstacles, explicit waypoints, shared-shunt policy and existing-route preservation
Automatic path through standard upload, complete readback, Save and Reload
Independent packed short-message decoding and ignored unrelated message families
Held note, release and repeated-press routing in a live-source simulation
Normal duration/event limits, cancellation, invalid data, source faults, retained partial observations and deterministic queue overflow
CLI/helper execution review and input-free listener validation
Relocated MCP path planning/review and live-access refusal
limits: Structural routing does not establish audibility, levels, DSP capacity or global I/O configuration
Caller supplies shunt identity, occupied waypoints and any shared-path/feedback intent
Path search is forward-grid only; final shared verifier can report feedback conflicts
Input-only listener never identifies hardware or executes mapped commands
Bounded subscription cannot recover events outside its scope or after input loss
Network transport and complete unsolicited device-change decoding remain separate
